characters.Kai: src/anim/cast.py KAI - lucky red Hawaiian shirt, shorts, flip-flops; works at the boardwalk surf shop
characters.Tess: 15, customer, dark ponytail, yellow hoodie, brave but scared, has never surfed
characters.The infected: grey-green skin, torn clothes, white eyes, slow then fast; they will not go into water

scenes.narration: The glass broke. Forty infected poured in. Kai and Tess ran for the ocean.
Lie flat, Kai said. Paddle. Don't look back.
They looked back. Every infected had stopped at the waterline. Not one step further.
Tess laughed. They had made it.
Then the water started moving. Fast. Straight out to sea.
A rip current. A river inside the ocean. It can outrun an Olympic swimmer.
Tess panicked, and paddled straight back toward the beach.
Stop, Kai shouted. You can't beat it. Nobody can.
Here's the rule lifeguards teach. Don't fight it. Go sideways, along the beach. Then come in.
So they paddled sideways. Arms burning.
On the sand, the infected walked with them. Matching every stroke.
Kai's board bumped something in the dark.
A man. Face down. In a lifeguard shirt.
Then his hand closed around Kai's ankle.
Kick free? Part three is next.
